title: Multi-WAN Load Balancer
summary: Adds USB tethering and Wi-Fi hotspot as extra internet sources and balances all links with mwan3 policies (balanced + failover).

items.title: Install Dependencies
items.description: Installs the mwan3 package set needed for balancing and failover.
items.usage_tip: Run it once before applying load balancing.

items.title: Setup USB Tethering WAN
items.description: Detects a tethered phone or modem interface (usb0, rndis0, eth1, eth2) and registers it as WAN with metric 20.
items.usage_tip: Enable USB tethering on the phone before running this option.

items.title: Setup Wi-Fi Hotspot WAN
items.description: Connects the router as a client to a phone hotspot or another Wi-Fi network and adds it as WWAN.
items.usage_tip: Station mode never touches your Access Point interfaces.

items.title: Apply mwan3 Load Balancing
items.description: Creates balanced and failover policies over WAN, USB WAN and Wi-Fi WAN, then restarts mwan3.
items.usage_tip: Traffic is spread across links; a single download will not reach the combined speed.

items.title: Show mwan3 Status
items.description: Prints the current mwan3 interface and policy status.
items.usage_tip: Use it to confirm which links are online right now.
